Definition: from G2476 (as standing prominently); the (entire external) bosom, i.e. chest:--breast.
BiblicalUsage: The breast is where the head rests and where the hand strikes. The disciple lying on Jesus' breast asks, Lord, who is it? The publican standing afar off smote upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner, and Peter sees the disciple who leaned on His breast at supper.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the breast holds both postures: the beloved leaning close, and the sinner beating his own chest for mercy.
